summary:
EARTHSCOPE AI – INTELLIGENT CLIMATE PATTERN DISCOVERY SYSTEM

EarthScope AI is an intelligent climate analysis and pattern discovery platform developed to understand long-term climate variations across different geographical regions of India. The project uses NASA POWER climate data to analyze historical environmental conditions and transform complex climate datasets into meaningful, understandable, and interactive insights.

Climate change is one of the major environmental challenges affecting communities, agriculture, ecosystems, and human activities. Changes in temperature, rainfall, humidity, and wind speed can influence environmental conditions and contribute to unusual weather patterns. However, understanding long-term climate variations across different cities can be difficult when dealing with large and complex datasets. EarthScope AI addresses this challenge by providing a centralized platform for exploring, analyzing, visualizing, and comparing climate information.

The project collects historical climate data through the NASA POWER API for ten major Indian cities: Bengaluru
